Digital Software Engineer Intermediate Analyst
description_html: The Digital Software Engineer Intermediate Analyst is an early-career software engineering role responsible for developing, testing, and supporting modern digital applications and services. The position provides opportunities to build experience with  Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud-native technologies, event-driven architectures, and API integrations  while working alongside experienced engineers and architects. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical aptitude, a willingness to learn, and a passion for delivering secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions in a collaborative Agile environment.      Responsibilities    Develop, test, and maintain applications using  Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices frameworks .  Support the design and implementation of  cloud-native applications  and services.  Participate in the development of  event-driven solutions  using messaging and integration technologies.  Build and support API integrations between internal and external systems.  Write secure, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards.  Participate in code reviews, testing activities, and Agile development ceremonies.  Troubleshoot and resolve application issues with guidance from senior engineers when needed.  Learn and apply modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and DevSecOps.  Utilize  AI-powered developer tools  to increase productivity, improve code quality, and accelerate learning.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver technology solutions that support business objectives.  Continuously expand technical knowledge of cloud, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems technologies.          Qualifications    1-3 years of software engineering or application development experience, including internships, co-ops, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Experience developing applications using  Java and Spring Boot .  Basic understanding of  microservices architecture , REST APIs, and distributed systems concepts.  Familiarity with  cloud-native development  principles and exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.  Exposure to  event-driven architectures , messaging technologies, or asynchronous processing concepts.  Experience developing, consuming, or supporting  RESTful APIs  and system integrations.  Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and modern engineering practices.  Familiarity with source control, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools such as Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.  Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and exposure to Kubernetes/OpenShift concepts is a plus.  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.  Eagerness to learn new technologies and contribute to modern engineering initiatives.         Preferred Qualifications    Experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience building applications with  Java, Spring Boot, APIs, or cloud technologies .  Exposure to Kafka, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies.  Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases.  Exposure to automated testing frameworks and software quality tools.  Experience using  AI-assisted development tools  such as GitHub Copilot or similar technologies to improve coding productivity and software quality.  Interest in cloud engineering, platform modernization, microservices, and DevOps practices.        Education:       Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience                 ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Digital Software Engineering            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $84,580.00 - $118,020.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards.
